name: Northwind Bank
notes: Strategic account. CIO is unhappy about two SSO outages in Q3 and has asked for a written root-cause analysis before renewal talks. Expansion into their wealth division is on hold until the SSO issue is closed.

name: Contoso Retail
notes: Rolled out invoice-processing automation to 40 stores. Champion is the VP Finance. Interested in demand-forecasting agents next year.

name: Fabrikam Insurance
notes: Claims team uses the platform daily. Procurement is pushing for a 15 percent discount at renewal. Usage dropped 20 percent in September after their data team was reorganised.

name: Tailspin Airlines
notes: Crew-rostering integration with their HR system went live in August. They want an on-premises deployment for the next phase because of data residency rules.
